ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, in triangle ABC, point C is a right angle, AB is the hypotenuse, AC is one right-angle side, and BC is the other right-angle side; the side opposite angle A is BC. According to the problem, AB=4 and AC=√7 are given. By the Pythagorean theorem, BC^2 = AB^2 - AC^2 = 4^2 - (√7)^2 = 16 - 7 = 9, so BC=3. Therefore sin A = opposite side/hypotenuse = BC/AB = 3/4.

method.method_draft: Compute cos A from the adjacent leg and hypotenuse, then use the Pythagorean trigonometric identity. From the diagram/text, AB is the hypotenuse and AC is adjacent to angle A, so cos A = AC/AB = sqrt(7)/4. Since A is an acute angle in a right triangle, sin A is positive. Apply sin^2 A + cos^2 A = 1: sin A = sqrt(1 - (sqrt(7)/4)^2) = sqrt(1 - 7/16) = sqrt(9/16) = 3/4.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是三角形 ABC，点 C 处为直角，AC 是竖直边，BC 是水平边，AB 是斜边；点 A 在右上方，点 B 在左下方。再推理：因为 \angle C=90^\circ，所以 AB 是斜边。对于角 A，边 AC 是邻边，AB 是斜边，因此 \cos A=\frac{AC}{AB}=\frac{\sqrt{7}}{4}。利用恒等式 \sin^2 A+\cos^2 A=1，得到 \sin A=\sqrt{1-\left(\frac{\sqrt{7}}{4}\right)^2}=\sqrt{1-\frac{7}{16}}=\sqrt{\frac{9}{16}}=\frac{3}{4}。由于 A 是直角三角形中的锐角，所以正弦取正值。
